qs.en: My name is Marc. What is your name?

qs.en: Can you give me your name?

qs.en: In French, 'table' is a noun.

qs.en: The name of this restaurant is very famous.

qs.s: L'importance de ___ famille est reconnue par tous.

qs.form: definite article with preposition de, feminine singular

qs.en: Large families receive government benefits.

qs.s: Ce remède a un bon _____ contre la douleur.
qs.en: This remedy has a good effect against pain.

qs.s: Ses paroles ont fait l'_____ d'une bombe dans la salle.
